48	@tilelang.jit(out_idx=[1], pass_configs=pass_configs)
49	def avg_pool3_d(*args):
50	    (
51	        n_batch, c_dim, d_dim, h_dim, w_dim, out_d, out_h, out_w,
52	        k_d, k_h, k_w, s_d, s_h, s_w, p_d, p_h, p_w,
53	        count_include_pad, divisor_override,
54	        block_c, dtype, split_mode, split_w_tile_kw, multi_w_window_w_num,
55	        in_spatial, out_spatial, m_out, block_m, m_num,
56	        used_core_num_m, tasks_per_core_m, vec_num, sub_block_m,
57	        pool_size, hw, split_block_c, c_num,
58	        total_blocks_mc, used_core_num_mc, tasks_per_core_mc,
59	        split_w_step, multi_w_window,
60	    ) = parse_block_args(*args)
61	
62	    def _process_rows(x_in, y_out, row_base, sub_block_m):
63	        for m in T.serial(sub_block_m):
64	            out_row = row_base + m
65	            n_idx, od, oh, ow = decompose_spatial(out_row, out_spatial, out_h, out_w)
66	            _ = (x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow)
67	
68	    def _process_split_c_rows(x_in, y_out, row_base, c_base, sub_block_m):
69	        for m in T.serial(sub_block_m):
70	            out_row = row_base + m
71	            n_idx, od, oh, ow = decompose_spatial(out_row, out_spatial, out_h, out_w)
72	            _ = (x_in, y_out, c_base, n_idx, od, oh, ow)
73	
74	    def _scope_process_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, vid):
75	        with T.Scope("V"):
76	            if bx < m_num:
77	                _process_rows(x_in, y_out, bx * block_m + vid * sub_block_m, sub_block_m)
78	
79	    def _scope_process_split_c_rows(*args):
80	        x_in, y_out, task_id, bx, bc, vid = args
81	        with T.Scope("V"):
82	            if task_id < total_blocks_mc:
83	                _process_split_c_rows(x_in, y_out, bx * block_m + vid * sub_block_m,
84	                                      bc * split_block_c, sub_block_m)
85	
86	    def _scope_process_multi_w_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, vid):
87	        with T.Scope("V"):
88	            if bx < m_num:
89	                _process_multi_w_rows(x_in, y_out, bx * block_m + vid * sub_block_m, sub_block_m)
90	
91	    def _process_multi_w_aligned(*args):
92	        x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow, m, sub_block_m = args
93	        for local_w in T.serial(multi_w_window):
94	            if local_w < sub_block_m - m and local_w < out_w - ow:
95	                _ = (x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow + local_w)
96	
97	    def _process_multi_w_prefix(*args):
98	        x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow, m, sub_block_m, prefix_len = args
99	        for local_w in T.serial(multi_w_window):
100	            if local_w < prefix_len and local_w < sub_block_m - m and local_w < out_w - ow:
101	                _ = (x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow + local_w)
102	
103	    def _process_multi_w_rows(x_in, y_out, row_base, sub_block_m):
104	        for m in T.serial(sub_block_m):
105	            out_row = row_base + m
106	            n_idx, od, oh, ow = decompose_spatial(out_row, out_spatial, out_h, out_w)
107	            if multi_w_window > 1 and ow % multi_w_window == 0:
108	                _process_multi_w_aligned(x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow, m, sub_block_m)
109	            elif m == 0:
110	                prefix_len = multi_w_window - (ow % multi_w_window)
111	                _process_multi_w_prefix(x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow, m, sub_block_m, prefix_len)
112	
113	    @T.prim_func
114	    def generic_3d(
115	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
116	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
117	    ):
118	        with T.Kernel(used_core_num_m, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
119	            core_idx = cid
120	            for local_idx in T.serial(tasks_per_core_m):
121	                bx = core_idx * tasks_per_core_m + local_idx
122	                _scope_process_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, vid)
123	
124	    @T.prim_func
125	    def reduce_d(
126	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
127	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
128	    ):
129	        with T.Kernel(used_core_num_m, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
130	            core_idx = cid
131	            for local_idx in T.serial(tasks_per_core_m):
132	                bx = core_idx * tasks_per_core_m + local_idx
133	                _scope_process_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, vid)
134	
135	    @T.prim_func
136	    def split_c(
137	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
138	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
139	    ):
140	        with T.Kernel(used_core_num_mc, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
141	            core_idx = cid
142	            for local_idx in T.serial(tasks_per_core_mc):
143	                task_id = core_idx * tasks_per_core_mc + local_idx
144	                bc = task_id // m_num
145	                bx = task_id % m_num
146	                _scope_process_split_c_rows(x_in, y_out, task_id, bx, bc, vid)
147	
148	    @T.prim_func
149	    def split_w(
150	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
151	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
152	    ):
153	        with T.Kernel(used_core_num_m, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
154	            core_idx = cid
155	            for local_idx in T.serial(tasks_per_core_m):
156	                bx = core_idx * tasks_per_core_m + local_idx
157	                _scope_process_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, vid)
158	
159	    @T.prim_func
160	    def multi_w(
161	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
162	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
163	    ):
164	        with T.Kernel(used_core_num_m, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
165	            core_idx = cid
166	            for local_idx in T.serial(tasks_per_core_m):
167	                bx = core_idx * tasks_per_core_m + local_idx
168	                _scope_process_multi_w_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, vid)
169	
170	    split_c_ready = block_c > 0 and c_dim % block_c == 0
171	    window = PoolSpatialWindow(k_h=k_h, k_w=k_w, s_h=s_h, s_w=s_w, p_h=p_h, p_w=p_w)
172	    impls = KernelImpls(generic_3d=generic_3d, reduce_d=reduce_d,
173	                        split_c=split_c, split_w=split_w, multi_w=multi_w)
174	    return resolve_kernel_mode(window, impls,
175	                                split_mode=split_mode, split_c_ready=split_c_ready,
176	                                multi_w_window=multi_w_window)
177

33	# NOTE: Each @T.prim_func below (generic_3d, reduce_d, split_c, split_w, multi_w)
34	# shares the same pipeline boilerplate (Kernel setup, UB allocation, row/block
35	# decomposition, spatial-dimension flattening).  This is intentional: T.lang

41	@tilelang.jit(out_idx=[1], pass_configs=pass_configs)
42	def avg_pool3_d(*args):
43	    a = parse_block_args(*args)
44	    (
45	        n_batch, c_dim, d_dim, h_dim, w_dim, out_d, out_h, out_w,
46	        k_d, k_h, k_w, s_d, s_h, s_w, p_d, p_h, p_w,
47	        count_include_pad, divisor_override,
48	        block_c, dtype, split_mode, split_w_tile_kw, multi_w_window_w_num,
49	        in_spatial, out_spatial, m_out, block_m, m_num,
50	        _, _, vec_num, sub_block_m,
51	        pool_size, hw, split_block_c, c_num,
52	        _, _, _,
53	        split_w_step, multi_w_window,
54	    ) = a
55	
56	    def _process_scope(*args, mode="generic"):
57	        if mode == "split_c":
58	            x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, row_base, c_base = args
59	        else:
60	            x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, row_base = args
61	            c_base = 0
62	        with T.Scope("V"):
63	            for m in T.serial(sub_block_m):
64	                _process_scope_row(
65	                    x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub,
66	                    row_base + m, c_base, mode,
67	                )
68	
69	    def _process_scope_row(*args):
70	        x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, out_row, c_base, mode = args
71	        n_idx, od, oh, ow = decompose_spatial(out_row, out_spatial, out_h, out_w)
72	        T.tile.fill(acc_ub, T.float32(0.0))
73	        for kd in T.serial(k_d):
74	            if mode == "reduce_d":
75	                _accumulate_reduce_d_slice(x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow, kd)
76	            elif mode == "split_w":
77	                _accumulate_split_w_slice(x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow, kd)
78	            else:
79	                _accumulate_depth_slice(x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow, kd, col=c_base)
80	        if divisor_override > 0:
81	            T.tile.mul(out_ub, acc_ub, T.float32(1.0 / divisor_override))
82	        else:
83	            T.tile.mul(out_ub, acc_ub, T.float32(1.0 / pool_size))
84	        T.copy(out_ub, y_out[out_row, c_base])

86	    @T.prim_func
87	    def generic_3d(
88	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
89	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
90	    ):
91	        with T.Kernel(m_num, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
92	            bx = cid
93	            row_base = bx * block_m + vid * sub_block_m
94	            acc_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
95	            inp_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
96	            out_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
97	            _process_scope(x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, row_base, mode="generic")
98	
99	    @T.prim_func
100	    def reduce_d(
101	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
102	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
103	    ):
104	        with T.Kernel(m_num, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
105	            bx = cid
106	            row_base = bx * block_m + vid * sub_block_m
107	            acc_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
108	            inp_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
109	            out_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
110	            _process_scope(x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, row_base, mode="reduce_d")
111	
112	    @T.prim_func
113	    def split_c(
114	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
115	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
116	    ):
117	        with T.Kernel(m_num * c_num, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
118	            bx = cid % m_num
119	            bc = cid // m_num
120	            row_base = bx * block_m + vid * sub_block_m
121	            c_base = bc * split_block_c
122	            acc_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, split_block_c), dtype)
123	            inp_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, split_block_c), dtype)
124	            out_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, split_block_c), dtype)
125	            _process_scope(x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, row_base, c_base, mode="split_c")
126	
127	    @T.prim_func
128	    def split_w(
129	        x_in: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
130	        y_out: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
131	    ):
132	        with T.Kernel(m_num, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
133	            bx = cid
134	            row_base = bx * block_m + vid * sub_block_m
135	            acc_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
136	            inp_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
137	            out_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, c_dim), dtype)
138	            _process_scope(x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, row_base, mode="split_w")
139	
140	    def _accumulate_reduce_d_slice(*args, col=0):
141	        x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow, kd = args
142	        id_val = od * s_d - p_d + kd
143	        if 0 <= id_val < d_dim:
144	            in_row = flatten_5d(n_idx, in_spatial, id_val, hw, oh, w_dim, ow)
145	            T.copy(x_in[in_row, col], inp_ub)
146	            T.tile.add(acc_ub, acc_ub, inp_ub)
147	
148	    def _accumulate_width_slice(*args, col=0):
149	        x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, id_val, ih_val, cur_ow = args
150	        for kw in T.serial(k_w):
151	            iw_val = cur_ow * s_w - p_w + kw
152	            if 0 <= iw_val < w_dim:
153	                in_row = flatten_5d(
154	                    n_idx, in_spatial,
155	                    id_val, hw, ih_val,
156	                    w_dim, iw_val)
157	                T.copy(x_in[in_row, col], inp_ub)
158	                T.tile.add(acc_ub, acc_ub, inp_ub)
159	
160	    def _accumulate_depth_slice(*args, col=0):
161	        x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, cur_ow, kd = args
162	        id_val = od * s_d - p_d + kd
163	        if 0 <= id_val < d_dim:
164	            for kh in T.serial(k_h):
165	                ih_val = oh * s_h - p_h + kh
166	                if 0 <= ih_val < h_dim:
167	                    _accumulate_width_slice(x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw,
168	                                            id_val, ih_val, cur_ow, col=col)
169	
170	    def _accumulate_split_w_element(*args):
171	        x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, id_val, ih_val, iw_val = args
172	        if 0 <= iw_val < w_dim:
173	            in_row = flatten_5d(
174	                n_idx, in_spatial,
175	                id_val, hw, ih_val,
176	                w_dim, iw_val)
177	            T.copy(x_in[in_row, 0], inp_ub)
178	            T.tile.add(acc_ub, acc_ub, inp_ub)
179	
180	    def _accumulate_split_w_chunk(*args):
181	        x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, id_val, ih_val, ow = args
182	        for kw_base in T.serial((k_w + split_w_step - 1) // split_w_step):
183	            for kw_local in T.serial(split_w_step):
184	                kw = kw_base * split_w_step + kw_local
185	                if kw < k_w:
186	                    iw_val = ow * s_w - p_w + kw
187	                    _accumulate_split_w_element(x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw,
188	                                                id_val, ih_val, iw_val)
189	
190	    def _accumulate_split_w_slice(*args):
191	        x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow, kd = args
192	        id_val = od * s_d - p_d + kd
193	        if 0 <= id_val < d_dim:
194	            for kh in T.serial(k_h):
195	                ih_val = oh * s_h - p_h + kh
196	                if 0 <= ih_val < h_dim:
197	                    _accumulate_split_w_chunk(x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw,
198	                                              id_val, ih_val, ow)
199	
200	    def _accumulate_window(*args):
201	        x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, y_out, out_row, local_w, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, cur_ow = args
202	        T.tile.fill(acc_ub, T.float32(0.0))
203	        for kd in T.serial(k_d):
204	            _accumulate_depth_slice(x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, cur_ow, kd)
205	        divisor = compute_pool_divisor(
206	            od, oh, cur_ow, k_d, k_h, k_w, s_d, s_h, s_w, p_d, p_h, p_w,
207	            d_dim, h_dim, w_dim, count_include_pad, divisor_override, pool_size)
208	        if divisor > 0:
209	            T.tile.mul(out_ub, acc_ub, T.float32(divisor))
210	        else:
211	            T.tile.fill(out_ub, T.float32(0.0))
212	        T.copy(out_ub, y_out[out_row + local_w, 0])
213	
214	    def _process_multi_w_aligned(*args):
215	        x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, out_row, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow, m, sub_block_m = args
216	        for local_w in T.serial(multi_w_window):
217	            if local_w < sub_block_m - m and local_w < out_w - ow:
218	                _accumulate_window(
219	                    x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, y_out, out_row, local_w,
220	                    n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow + local_w)
221	
222	    def _process_multi_w_prefix(*args):
223	        x_in, y_out, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, out_row, n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow, m, sub_block_m, prefix_len = (
224	            args
225	        )
226	        for local_w in T.serial(multi_w_window):
227	            if local_w < prefix_len and local_w < sub_block_m - m and local_w < out_w - ow:
228	                _accumulate_window(
229	                    x_in, acc_ub, inp_ub, out_ub, y_out, out_row, local_w,
230	                    n_idx, in_spatial, hw, od, oh, ow + local_w)
231

"""Shared types and utilities for max_pool3d TileLang design."""

import dataclasses
import tilelang

pass_configs = {
    tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_ASCEND_AUTO_SYNC: True,
}


def decompose_spatial(out_row, out_spatial, out_h, out_w):
    """Decompose a flat output row index into (n, od, oh, ow).

    Output layout: row_stride = out_spatial, then od*outH*outW + oh*outW + ow.
    """
    n_idx = out_row // out_spatial
    rem = out_row % out_spatial
    od = rem // (out_h * out_w)
    rem = rem % (out_h * out_w)
    oh = rem // out_w
    ow = rem % out_w
    return n_idx, od, oh, ow


def flatten_5d(n, in_spatial, d, hw, h, w_dim, w):
    """Flatten (n, d, h, w) index into a flat input row index.

    Input layout: (N * D * H * W, C).  Row = n*in_spatial + d*h*w + h*w + w.
    Here hw = H*W (precomputed) so d*hw gives the base offset for depth d.
    """
    return n * in_spatial + d * hw + h * w_dim + w


@dataclasses.dataclass
class KernelImpls:
    """Container for the available kernel implementations.

    For max_pool3d we only need a generic path and an optional split_c path.
    """

    generic: object
    split_c: object = None


def resolve_kernel_mode(impls: KernelImpls, split_c_enabled: bool = False):
    """Select kernel implementation based on availability.

    If split_c is enabled and available, prefer it (better for large C).
    Otherwise fall back to generic.
    """
    if split_c_enabled and impls.split_c is not None:
        return impls.split_c
    return impls.generic

"""Block-level TileLang design for max_pool3d.

This file defines the block decomposition and pipeline skeleton for 3D max pooling.
Fine-grained compute details are left as TODO(tile-level) markers.

Design overview
================

MaxPool3d input:  NCDHW  (batch, channel, depth, height, width)
MaxPool3d output: NCDHW  (batch, channel, out_depth, out_height, out_width)

Layout transformation (done in model_new_tilelang.py):
  NCDHW  -->  NDHWC  -->  (N * D * H * W, C)   for input
  NCDHW  -->  NDHWC  -->  (N * outD * outH * outW, C)   for output

Block decomposition:
  - Flatten output spatial: m_out = N * outD * outH * outW
  - Each block handles block_m output rows
  - If C is large, further split C into tile_c channel blocks
  - total_blocks = ceil(m_out / block_m) * ceil(C / tile_c)

Pipeline (Vector-only, no Cube involvement):
  For each output row in the block's range:
    1. Initialize max accumulator to -inf (float32 for numerical stability)
    2. For each kernel position (kd, kh, kw):
       a. Compute input coordinates (id, ih, iw) from output coords + params
       b. If valid, load input row into UB, cast to float32
       c. Elementwise max with accumulator
    3. Cast result back to input dtype
    4. Write to output
"""

from pathlib import Path

import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T

# Import shared utilities from the common module.
_COMMON_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(_COMMON_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_COMMON_DIR))

    pass_configs,
    decompose_spatial,
    flatten_5d,
    KernelImpls,
    resolve_kernel_mode,
)

    p_d, p_h, p_w, dil_d, dil_h, dil_w,
    dtype="float16",
):
    """Block-level max_pool3d kernel generator.

    Parameters
    ----------
    All parameters are Python integers or strings known at trace-time.
    The kernel operates on the flattened layout (N*spatial, C).
    """
    # Spatial decomposition
    in_spatial = d_dim * h_dim * w_dim
    out_spatial = out_d * out_h * out_w
    hw = h_dim * w_dim  # precomputed H*W for flatten_5d
    m_out = n_batch * out_spatial

    # Block-level tiling parameters
    block_m = 64          # number of output rows per spatial block
    tile_c = 256          # channels per channel block (when split_c)
    vec_num = 1           # vector-side split factor
    sub_block_m = block_m // vec_num

    # Compute block counts
    m_num = (m_out + block_m - 1) // block_m
    c_num = (c_dim + tile_c - 1) // tile_c
    total_blocks_mc = m_num * c_num

    # Determine if split_c is beneficial
    split_c_enabled = c_dim > tile_c

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helper: process one output row (spatial iteration skeleton)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _process_rows(x_in, y_out, row_base, c_base, cur_c):
        """Iterate over sub-block rows.  Actual pooling goes into TODO."""
        for m in T.serial(sub_block_m):
            out_row = row_base + m
            if out_row < m_out:
                n_idx, od, oh, ow = decompose_spatial(out_row, out_spatial, out_h, out_w)
                _ = (x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow, c_base, cur_c)
                # TODO(tile-level):
                # - alloc acc_ub[cur_c] in float32: T.alloc_ub((1, cur_c), "float32")
                # - alloc inp_ub[cur_c] in float32

                #           for kw in T.serial(k_w):

                #             if 0 <= iw_val < w_dim:
                #               in_row = flatten_5d(n_idx, in_spatial, id_val, hw, ih_val, w_dim, iw_val)
                #               T.copy(x_in[in_row, c_base], inp_ub)  # load cur_c elements
                #               T.tile.max(acc_ub, acc_ub, inp_ub)    # elementwise max
                # - T.copy(acc_ub, y_out[out_row, c_base])  # write result

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Vector-side scope wrapper
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _scope_process_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, bc):
        """Enter Vector scope and process the rows in this block."""
        row_base = bx * block_m
        c_base = bc * tile_c
        c_end = T.min(c_base + tile_c, c_dim)
        cur_c = c_end - c_base
        with T.Scope("V"):
            if bx < m_num:
                _process_rows(x_in, y_out, row_base, c_base, cur_c)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # generic prim_func: all C in one block (no channel split)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @T.prim_func
    def generic(
        X: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
        Y: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(m_num, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
            bx = cid
            # In generic mode, c_base=0, cur_c=c_dim
            _scope_process_rows(X, Y, bx, T.cast(0, "int32"))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # split_c prim_func: split C across multiple blocks
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @T.prim_func
    def split_c(
        X: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
        Y: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(total_blocks_mc, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
            bx = cid % m_num
            bc = cid // m_num
            _scope_process_rows(X, Y, bx, bc)

    impls = KernelImpls(generic=generic, split_c=split_c)
    return resolve_kernel_mode(impls, split_c_enabled=split_c_enabled)

"""Tile-level TileLang design for max_pool3d.

This file fills in the computation details that were marked TODO(tile-level)
in the block-level design.  It implements 3D max pooling by iterating over
the kernel window and computing elementwise max for each channel tile.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import tilelang
import tilelang.language as T

# Import shared utilities from the common module.
_COMMON_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
if str(_COMMON_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_COMMON_DIR))
from max_pool3d_common import (  # noqa: E402
    pass_configs,
    decompose_spatial,
    flatten_5d,
    KernelImpls,
    resolve_kernel_mode,
)


@tilelang.jit(out_idx=[1], pass_configs=pass_configs)
def max_pool3d(
    n_batch, c_dim, d_dim, h_dim, w_dim,
    out_d, out_h, out_w,
    k_d, k_h, k_w, s_d, s_h, s_w,
    p_d, p_h, p_w, dil_d, dil_h, dil_w,
    dtype="float16",
):
    """Tile-level max_pool3d kernel generator with full computation.

    Operates on the flattened layout:  X: (N*in_spatial, C), Y: (m_out, C).
    """
    # Spatial decomposition
    in_spatial = d_dim * h_dim * w_dim
    out_spatial = out_d * out_h * out_w
    hw = h_dim * w_dim
    m_out = n_batch * out_spatial

    # Block-level tiling parameters (must match block_level)
    block_m = 64
    tile_c = 256
    vec_num = 1
    sub_block_m = block_m // vec_num

    m_num = (m_out + block_m - 1) // block_m
    c_num = (c_dim + tile_c - 1) // tile_c
    total_blocks_mc = m_num * c_num
    split_c_enabled = c_dim > tile_c

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Core pooling computation for a single output row and channel tile
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _max_pool_3d_row(x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow, c_base, cur_c):
        """Compute max pooling for output position (n_idx, od, oh, ow)
        over channels [c_base, c_base+cur_c).

        Algorithm:
          1. Initialize acc_ub (float32) to -FLT_MAX.
          2. For each kernel position (kd, kh, kw):
             a. Compute input coords with stride, pad, dilation.
             b. If valid, load input row slice, cast to fp32, max with acc.
          3. Cast acc back to input dtype and write to output.
        """
        acc_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, cur_c), "float32")
        inp_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, cur_c), "float32")
        inp_half_ub = T.alloc_ub((1, cur_c), dtype)

        # Initialize accumulator to a very large negative value
        T.tile.fill(acc_ub, T.float32(-3.402823466e+38))

        for kd in T.serial(k_d):
            id_val = od * s_d + kd * dil_d - p_d
            if 0 <= id_val < d_dim:
                for kh in T.serial(k_h):
                    ih_val = oh * s_h + kh * dil_h - p_h
                    if 0 <= ih_val < h_dim:
                        for kw in T.serial(k_w):
                            iw_val = ow * s_w + kw * dil_w - p_w
                            if 0 <= iw_val < w_dim:
                                in_row = flatten_5d(
                                    n_idx, in_spatial,
                                    id_val, hw, ih_val, w_dim, iw_val,
                                )
                                # Load input slice, cast to fp32, elementwise max
                                T.copy(x_in[in_row, c_base], inp_half_ub)
                                T.tile.cast(inp_ub, inp_half_ub,
                                            mode="CAST_NONE", count=cur_c)
                                T.tile.max(acc_ub, acc_ub, inp_ub)

        # Cast result back to input dtype and write to output
        T.tile.cast(inp_half_ub, acc_ub, mode="CAST_ROUND", count=cur_c)
        T.copy(inp_half_ub, y_out[out_row, c_base])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Process a sub-block of rows within a channel tile
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _process_rows(x_in, y_out, row_base, c_base, cur_c):
        for m in T.serial(sub_block_m):
            out_row = row_base + m
            if out_row < m_out:
                n_idx, od, oh, ow = decompose_spatial(
                    out_row, out_spatial, out_h, out_w,
                )
                _max_pool_3d_row(x_in, y_out, n_idx, od, oh, ow, c_base, cur_c)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Vector-side scope wrapper
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _scope_process_rows(x_in, y_out, bx, bc):
        row_base = bx * block_m
        c_base = bc * tile_c
        c_end = T.min(c_base + tile_c, c_dim)
        cur_c = c_end - c_base
        with T.Scope("V"):
            if bx < m_num:
                _process_rows(x_in, y_out, row_base, c_base, cur_c)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # generic prim_func
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @T.prim_func
    def generic(
        X: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
        Y: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(m_num, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
            bx = cid
            _scope_process_rows(X, Y, bx, T.cast(0, "int32"))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # split_c prim_func
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    @T.prim_func
    def split_c(
        X: T.Tensor((n_batch * in_spatial, c_dim), dtype),
        Y: T.Tensor((m_out, c_dim), dtype),
    ):
        with T.Kernel(total_blocks_mc, is_npu=True) as (cid, vid):
            bx = cid % m_num
            bc = cid // m_num
            _scope_process_rows(X, Y, bx, bc)

    impls = KernelImpls(generic=generic, split_c=split_c)
    return resolve_kernel_mode(impls, split_c_enabled=split_c_enabled)

"""TileLang implementation for MaxPool3d.

Layout transformation:
  NCDHW  ->  NDHWC  ->  flatten spatial -> (N*D*H*W, C)
  kernel computes max pooling on the flattened layout.

The kernel is loaded from design/tile_level/max_pool3d.py.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

_TASK_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
if str(_TASK_DIR) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_TASK_DIR))

from design.tile_level.max_pool3d import max_pool3d as tl_max_pool3d  # noqa: E402


def _expand_to_3(param, default):
    """Expand a scalar or None parameter to a 3-element tuple."""
    if param is None:
        return (default, default, default)
    if isinstance(param, int):
        return (param, param, param)
    if isinstance(param, (list, tuple)):
        if len(param) == 1:
            return (param[0], param[0], param[0])
        return tuple(param)
    return (param, param, param)


class ModelNew(nn.Module):
    """TileLang MaxPool3d model.

    Converts NCDHW input to NDHWC, flattens spatial dims, calls the TileLang
    kernel, then converts output back to NCDHW.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()

    def forward(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        kernel_size,
        stride=None,
        padding: int = 0,
        dilation: int = 1,
        ceil_mode: bool = False,
        return_indices: bool = False,
    ):
        """Applies 3D max pooling using a custom TileLang kernel.

        Args:
            x: Input tensor of shape (N, C, D, H, W).
            kernel_size: Size of the pooling window (int or 3-tuple).
            stride: Stride (int or 3-tuple). Defaults to kernel_size.
            padding: Implicit zero padding (int or 3-tuple).
            dilation: Spacing between kernel elements (int or 3-tuple).
            ceil_mode: Use ceil instead of floor for output shape.
            return_indices: Not supported in this TileLang kernel.

        Returns:
            torch.Tensor of shape (N, C, outD, outH, outW).
        """
        if x.ndim != 5:
            raise ValueError(f"Expected 5D input (N,C,D,H,W), got shape={tuple(x.shape)}")
        if x.dtype not in (torch.float16, torch.float32, torch.bfloat16):
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported dtype {x.dtype}")

        n, c, d_in, h_in, w_in = x.shape

        # Expand params to 3-element tuples
        k = _expand_to_3(kernel_size, 1)
        s = _expand_to_3(stride, k[0] if stride is None else stride)
        p = _expand_to_3(padding, 0)
        dil = _expand_to_3(dilation, 1)

        k_d, k_h, k_w = k
        s_d, s_h, s_w = s
        p_d, p_h, p_w = p
        dil_d, dil_h, dil_w = dil

        # Compute effective kernel size (accounting for dilation)
        eff_kd = dil_d * (k_d - 1) + 1
        eff_kh = dil_h * (k_h - 1) + 1
        eff_kw = dil_w * (k_w - 1) + 1

        # Compute output dimensions
        if not ceil_mode:
            o_d = (d_in + 2 * p_d - eff_kd) // s_d + 1
            o_h = (h_in + 2 * p_h - eff_kh) // s_h + 1
            o_w = (w_in + 2 * p_w - eff_kw) // s_w + 1
        else:
            o_d = (d_in + 2 * p_d - eff_kd + s_d - 1) // s_d + 1
            o_h = (h_in + 2 * p_h - eff_kh + s_h - 1) // s_h + 1
            o_w = (w_in + 2 * p_w - eff_kw + s_w - 1) // s_w + 1
            # Clip: if the last pooling window starts beyond the padded input, shrink output
            if (o_d - 1) * s_d >= d_in + p_d:
                o_d -= 1
            if (o_h - 1) * s_h >= h_in + p_h:
                o_h -= 1
            if (o_w - 1) * s_w >= w_in + p_w:
                o_w -= 1

        o_d = max(1, o_d)
        o_h = max(1, o_h)
        o_w = max(1, o_w)

        # Convert layout: NCDHW -> NDHWC
        x_ndhwc = x.permute(0, 2, 3, 4, 1).contiguous()
        # Flatten spatial: (N, D, H, W, C) -> (N*D*H*W, C)
        x_flat = x_ndhwc.reshape(n * d_in * h_in * w_in, c)

        # Build and run kernel
        dtype_str = str(x.dtype).split(".")[-1]
        kernel = tl_max_pool3d(
            n, c, d_in, h_in, w_in,
            o_d, o_h, o_w,
            k_d, k_h, k_w, s_d, s_h, s_w,
            p_d, p_h, p_w, dil_d, dil_h, dil_w,
            dtype=dtype_str,
        )
        y_flat = kernel(x_flat)

        # Convert output back: (N*outD*outH*outW, C) -> (N, outD, outH, outW, C) -> NCDHW
        y = y_flat.reshape(n, o_d, o_h, o_w, c).permute(0, 4, 1, 2, 3).contiguous()
        return y


def get_input_groups():
    """Delegate to the original model's get_input_groups."""
    from model import get_input_groups as _get_input_groups
    return _get_input_groups()

   #include "ops.h"
   #include <torch/library.h>

   TORCH_LIBRARY_FRAGMENT(npu, m) {

6	- 对于部分 API，tensor-tensor 和 tensor-scalar 的 lowering 不同，分别列出。

8	## 数据搬运
9	
10	| TileLang API | AscendC API | 备注 |
11	| --- | --- | --- |
12	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`GM -> L1`) | `AscendC::DataCopy(...)` | 常见为 `DataCopy(..., Nd2NzParams)`；若目标是 `TQue`，配合 `AllocTensor` 和 `EnQue`。 |
13	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`L1 -> L0A`) | `AscendC::LoadData(...)` / `AscendC::LoadDataWithTranspose(...)` | 是否转置取决于 layout。 |
14	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`L1 -> L0B`) | `AscendC::LoadData(...)` / `AscendC::LoadDataWithTranspose(...)` | 是否转置取决于 layout。 |
15	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`L0C -> GM`) | `AscendC::Fixpipe(...)` |  |
16	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`GM -> UB`) | `AscendC::DataCopyPad(local, global, copyParams, padParams)` | 若目标是 `TQue`，配合 `AllocTensor` 和 `EnQue`；如果是矩阵的二维子 tile，常改用 `DataCopy` + `DataCopyParams`。 |
17	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`UB -> GM`) | `AscendC::DataCopyPad(global, local, copyParams)` | 若来源是 `TQue`，配合 `DeQue` 和 `FreeTensor`；如果是写回矩阵的二维子 tile，常改用 `DataCopy` + `DataCopyParams`。 |
18	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`UB -> UB`, same dtype) | `AscendC::DataCopy(...)` |  |
19	| `T.copy(src, dst)` (`UB -> UB`, cast dtype) | `AscendC::Cast(...)` |  |

21	### DataCopy / DataCopyPad 注意事项
22	
23	- `DataCopyPad` 的 `GM -> UB` 和 `UB -> GM` 参数个数不同：
24	  - `GM -> UB`：`DataCopyPad(local, global, copyParams, padParams)`，需要 4 参数，并传入 `DataCopyPadExtParams<T>`。
25	  - `UB -> GM`：`DataCopyPad(global, local, copyParams)`，只需要 3 参数，不传 `padParams`。
26	- `DataCopyExtParams` 常用字段为 `blockCount, blockLen, srcStride, dstStride, rsv`；其中 `blockLen` 单位是字节，`srcStride`/`dstStride` 的单位随 GM 或 Local 位置变化。
27	- `DataCopyPadExtParams<T>` 常用字段为 `isPad, leftPadding, rightPadding, padValue`；`isPad` 属于 `DataCopyPadExtParams<T>`，不要写进 `DataCopyExtParams`。
28	- 参与 `GM <-> UB` 搬运的 UB buffer 优先映射为 `TQue` 分配的 `LocalTensor`，并按方向配合 `AllocTensor`/`EnQue` 或 `DeQue`/`FreeTensor`；不要把直接参与 `DataCopy` / `DataCopyPad` 的 buffer 映射为普通 `TBuf`。
29	- 连续且 32B 对齐的搬运优先用 `DataCopy`；非对齐、尾块或需要补齐时再用 `DataCopyPad`。
30	- 矩阵二维子 tile 或带 stride 的搬运应显式构造 `DataCopyParams` / `DataCopyExtParams`。
31	- 普通 `UB -> UB` 搬运优先用 `DataCopy`；`Local -> Local` 的 `DataCopyPad + Nd2NzParams` 属于特殊格式转换路径，不按普通 `T.copy(UB -> UB)` 套用。

1	## TileLang 设计转换到 AscendC Kernel 关键原则
2	
3	本文档讨论如何将已经完成的 TileLang 设计，系统地转换为等价的 AscendC 实现。本文中的 DSL 特指 TileLang。后文中的 tiling、绑定层、主 kernel 类、子模块拆分与同步关系，都应以 TileLang 尤其是 tile-level 设计为直接来源。
4	
5	1. **先看 Mapping，再查 API 文档**
6	   转换时，应先阅读 `@references/TileLang-AscendC-API-Mapping.md`，先确认 TileLang API 到 AscendC API 的映射关系，再去阅读 `asc-devkit/docs/` 目录下对应的具体 API 文档。
7	   知识库入口：`api_reference/INDEX.md`
8	
9	2. **禁止在 C++ 中直接调用 torch / ATen 计算接口**
10	   `pybind11.cpp` 中禁止使用 `torch::*`、`torch::nn::functional::*`、`ATen` 库或任何 `at::*` 计算接口来实现或替代核心计算，包括但不限于 `at::einsum`、`at::matmul`、`at::softmax`、`at::bmm` 等。绑定层只负责参数检查、输出与 workspace 分配、tiling 填充和 kernel launch，不允许把核心计算留在 C++/ATen 侧。
11	---
12	
13	## TileLang 到 AscendC 转换总览
14	
15	一个从 TileLang 设计转换得到的 AscendC 实现，通常包含 4 部分：
16	
17	1. **Host 侧准备**：`xxx_tiling.h` + `pybind11.cpp`
18	   这两部分共同构成 AscendC 的 host 侧准备逻辑，通常需要结合 TileLang kernel 的 host 信息一起整理。`xxx_tiling.h` 负责定义 shape、block size、tile size、workspace 深度等参数；`pybind11.cpp` 负责 Python 接口、输入校验、输出与 workspace 分配、tiling 构造和 kernel launch。
19	
20	2. **公共工具**：如 `kernel_common.h`、`workspace_queue.h`、`matmul_tile.h`, `vector_tile.h`
21	   提供调度、数据搬运、workspace 管理等通用能力。
22	
23	3. **Kernel 入口**：`xxx.cpp`
24	   定义 `__global__ __aicore__` kernel 和 `extern "C"` launch 函数。
25	
26	4. **主 Kernel 类与计算子模块**：一个或多个 `*.h`
27	   主 `Kernel` 类负责 `Init()` / `Process()` 主流程，管理 GM tensor、调度和流水。若 TileLang 中存在多个 `T.prim_func`，将对应的主 `Kernel` 类拆到多个独立头文件中，例如 `xxx_merge_n_kernel.h`、`xxx_single_row_kernel.h`。若算子属于 C/V 融合算子，或者 TileLang 设备侧存在多个有明确职责分工的 `Scope`，则可在这一部分下继续按计算阶段拆分子模块，例如 `matmul.h`、`leakyrelu.h`；通常每个 `Scope` 对应一个子模块，职责应与原 TileLang 设计中的计算阶段一一对应。对于纯 Vector 算子，或者虽然有 host / queue / buffer 管理但设备侧只有单个 Vector 计算阶段 / 单个 Vector `Scope` 的简单算子，主 `Kernel` 类本身通常就承载全部计算逻辑，不再额外拆分子模块。
28	
29	### `T.prim_func` 到 AscendC Kernel 的映射规则
30	
31	TileLang 中有多少个 `T.prim_func`，AscendC 侧就至少要有多少个独立的 kernel 实现单元。不要把多个 `T.prim_func` 折叠进同一个 `Kernel` 类里再靠运行时分支区分。
32	
33	具体要求：
34	
35	- 每个 `T.prim_func` 都应对应一个独立的主 `Kernel` 类。
36	- 每个 `T.prim_func` 都应对应至少一个独立的 `__global__ __aicore__` kernel 入口和一个匹配的 `extern "C"` launch 函数。
37	- 如果同一个 `T.prim_func` 需要按 dtype 分成多个实现，例如 fp16 / fp32 / int8，则可以在该 `prim_func` 之下派生出更多 `extern` 入口；但主 `Kernel` 类的个数仍应首先与 `T.prim_func` 的个数对齐。
38	- Host 侧 `pybind11.cpp` 负责根据 shape、dtype 或其他 trace-time 条件，选择调用哪个 `extern` 入口；这种选择逻辑不应反向合并掉 `prim_func` 级别的结构差异。
39	
40	例如，若 TileLang 提供 `merge_n` 和 `single_row` 两个 `T.prim_func`，则 AscendC 至少应有两个主 `Kernel` 类、两个 `__global__ __aicore__` 入口和两个 `extern "C"` launch 函数；若两者还各自支持多种 dtype，则 `extern` 数量可以更多，但主 `Kernel` 类仍至少是两个。

44	## 第一章：Host 侧准备（摘要）
45	
46	完整实现细节与代码示例见 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_host.md`。
47	
48	**要点**：
49	
50	- **Tiling 参数一致性**：所有 kernel 组件（Cube/Vector/Host）必须使用同一组 baseM/baseN/baseK 常量，参数不匹配会导致错误的内存访问。
51	- **Tiling Struct**：在 Host 侧预计算 `nTiles`、`nTilesPerH` 等派生量写入 tiling struct，避免 kernel 里重复除法。
52	- **绑定层职责**：`pybind11.cpp` 负责参数检查、输出分配、workspace 分配、tiling 构造、kernel launch。绑定函数只接收 DSL 显式输入张量，不接收输出和 workspace。
53	- **模块名**：推荐 `_<op_name>_ext`，不要与任务目录同名。
54	- **Workspace**：只要 DSL 声明了 workspace 参数或 `workspace_idx`，就必须分配 workspace。

91	## 第四章：主 Kernel 类与计算子模块（摘要）
92	
93	完整实现细节与代码示例见：
94	
95	- 纯 Vector 算子：`@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_vector.md`
96	- 纯 Cube 算子：`@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_cube.md`
97	- C/V 融合算子：先看 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_cv.md`，再结合 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_cube.md` 和 `@references/dsl2Ascendc_compute_vector.md`
98	
99	**常见陷阱速查表**：
100	
101	| 问题 | 症状 | 解决方法 |
102	|:---|:---|:---|
103	| local UB buffer 该用 `TQue` 却写成 `TBuf` | 结果系统性错误或生命周期错乱 | 在 `T.serial` 中的输入/输出 buffer 用 `TQue` |
104	| TQue depth=0 用了返回值形式 API | 编译报错 | VECIN/VECOUT 必须用引用形式 |
105	| TBuf DataCopy 后缺少 PipeBarrier | 结果随机错误 | 插入 `PipeBarrier<PIPE_MTE2>()` |
106	| Fixpipe 未同步 | 流同步超时 | CrossCoreSetFlag 使用 `PIPE_FIX` |
107	| 内层循环中重复 DeQue | 结果错误 | 每个外层迭代只 DeQue 一次 |
108	| Fixpipe dstStride = baseN | tile 间数据覆盖 | dstStride 应设为完整行宽 N |
109	| WholeReduceMax 参数错误 | 编译报错 | 改用 `ReduceMax(dst, src, workBuf, count)` |
110	| 使用不存在的 Divs | 编译报错 | 改用 `Muls(dst, src, 1.0f/scaleVal, count)` |
111	| scan 算子（cumsum 等）fp16 2D `dim=0` 验证失败 | NPU `torch.cumsum` 对 fp16 2D `dim=0` 使用非确定性并行扫描，参考输出本身不一致 | 见下方「Scan 类算子转译注意事项」：monkey-patch `torch.cumsum` + 混合 accumulation 精度 |
112	
113	---
114	
115	## Scan 类算子（cumsum / cumprod 等）转译注意事项
116	
117	### 1. NPU `torch.cumsum` fp16 2D `dim=0` 的已知 bug
118	
119	当算子属于 scan 类（inclusive scan、prefix sum 等），且参考实现调用 `torch.cumsum` 时，**必须注意** NPU 上存在以下已知问题：
120	
121	- 对 **float16、2D tensor、沿 `dim=0`（strided scan）** 的场景，`torch.cumsum` 内部使用非确定性并行扫描，导致：
122	  - 小 tensor：多次运行结果随机波动（~0.1-0.5% mismatch）
123	  - 大 tensor：系统性偏离正确值（~10%）
124	- 同一 tensor 沿 `dim=1`（contiguous scan）则使用确定性串行扫描，结果稳定。
125	
126	### 2. `model_new_ascendc.py` 中的标准 Workaround
127	
128	转译 scan 类算子时，应在 `model_new_ascendc.py` 中实施以下模式（以 cumsum 为例）：
129	
130	**步骤 A：Monkey-patch `torch.cumsum`**
131	在模块顶部拦截 `torch.cumsum`，将 2D fp16 `dim=0` 自动转译为 `cumsum(x.T, dim=1).T`，迫使参考模型走稳定的 contiguous scan 路径：
132	
133	```python
134	_original_cumsum = torch.cumsum
135	
136	def _patched_cumsum(input, dim, *args, **kwargs):
137	    if input.dim() == 2 and input.dtype == torch.float16 and dim in (0, -2):
138	        return _original_cumsum(input.T, dim=1).T
139	    return _original_cumsum(input, dim, *args, **kwargs)
140	
141	torch.cumsum = _patched_cumsum
142	```
143	
144	**步骤 B：Kernel 内部必须实现混合 accumulation 精度（硬性要求）**
145	仅在 kernel 中固定使用 fp32 accumulation 或固定使用 fp16 accumulation 都无法覆盖全部 case，必须在 kernel 中通过 tiling 参数（如 `useFp32Acc`）支持两种模式切换，并在 Python wrapper 中根据 scan 长度 `L` 动态选择：
146	
147	- **小 tensor（scan 长度 `L <= 512`）**：NPU 参考走纯 fp16 串行扫描，kernel 必须切换为 **fp16 accumulation**。实现方式：每步先将 fp32 acc cast 到 fp16，再 cast 回 fp32 与输入相加，确保逐元素舍入行为与参考一致。
148	- **大 tensor（`L > 512`）**：NPU 参考在 fp16 路径下仍表现出类似 fp32 的行为，kernel 使用 **fp32 accumulation**（全程 fp32 累加，最后统一 cast 到 fp16），利用大数值下 `rtol` 容忍度较宽的特点通过验证。
149	
150	 wrapper 中判断逻辑示例：
151	```python
152	is_last_dim = dim_pos == x.ndim - 1
153	is_4d_non_last = x.ndim >= 4 and dim_pos >= 1
154	is_2d_dim0 = x.ndim == 2 and dim_pos == 0
155	use_fp32 = (x.dtype == torch.float16) and not (
156	    is_last_dim or is_4d_non_last or (is_2d_dim0 and x.shape[dim] <= 512)
157	)
158	```
159	
160	**步骤 C：Fp16 输出 cast 模式（硬性要求）**
161	将 fp32 acc cast 到 fp16 时，**必须使用** `AscendC::RoundMode::CAST_NONE`（截断）。经验证，`CAST_ROUND` 会导致 fp16 小 tensor case 产生额外 ~0.1-0.5% mismatch，而 `CAST_NONE` 与 NPU PyTorch 的舍入行为最接近。
162	
163	### 3. 通用化要点
164	
165	- **bf16 与 fp16 的区别**：经实测，NPU `torch.cumsum` 对 **bfloat16** 的 2D `dim=0` 场景**没有**非确定性并行扫描 bug，多次运行结果稳定，且 `dim=0` 与 `dim=1-of-transpose` 结果完全一致。因此 monkey-patch 和混合 accumulation 精度策略**仅针对 fp16**，bf16 可保持常规 fp32 accumulation 实现。但 fp16 输出 cast 为 `CAST_NONE` 的建议对 bf16 同样适用。
166	- 以上模式不仅限于 `cumsum`，任何**参考实现依赖 `torch.cumsum` 的 scan 类算子**（如 `cumprod`）在 fp16 2D `dim=0` 场景下均应检查并应用相同 workaround。
167	- 若 TileLang 设计中的 scan 算子后来被转译为 AscendC，转译时应确保 kernel 支持 `useFp32Acc` 切换，并在 wrapper 中根据原始 stride / shape 信息动态选择精度策略。
168	- 若算子本身不是 scan 类，但内部包含 prefix sum 作为子步骤（如某些 sort / argsort 实现），也应审视该子步骤是否触发相同的 NPU bug。

{"content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Wheel packaging for max_pool3d AscendC kernel."""

import os
import glob
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import setuptools
from setuptools.command.build_ext import build_ext
from torch_npu.utils.cpp_extension import NpuExtension

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BUILD_DIR = HERE / "build"


class BuildExt(build_ext):
    def run(self):
        so_files = glob.glob(str(BUILD_DIR / "max_pool3d_ext*.so"))
        if not so_files:
            os.makedirs(BUILD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
            soc_ver = os.environ.get("SOC_VERSION", "Ascend910B2")
            ascend = os.environ.get("ASCEND_HOME_PATH", "")
            subprocess.check_call(
                ["cmake", str(HERE),
                 f"-DSOC_VERSION={soc_ver}",
                 f"-DASCEND_CANN_PACKAGE_PATH={ascend}",
                 "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release"],
                cwd=BUILD_DIR)
            subprocess.check_call(
                ["make", f"-j{os.cpu_count()}"], cwd=BUILD_DIR)

        self.build_lib = str(BUILD_DIR)
        super().run()


setuptools.setup(
    name="max_pool3d",
    version="0.1.0",
    description="MaxPool3d AscendC kernel",
    ext_modules=[NpuExtension("max_pool3d_ext", sources=[])],
    cmdclass={"build_ext": BuildExt},
    license="BSD 3-Clause",
    python_requires=">=3.8",
)

## 流程

1. **准备性能测试**

```markdown
## 性能分析报告

### 测试环境
- 设备: {device}
- warmup: {warmup} 轮
- repeat: {repeat} 轮

| 实现 | 平均耗时(ms) | 加速比(vs 参考) |

| AscendC | {time} | {speedup}x |

### 结论
{分析结论，如哪种实现最优、是否达到预期加速等}
```

# Trace 记录 Skill

你是一名执行 trace 记录员。你的目标是在算子任务完成后，回顾整个执行过程，生成结构化的 trace 记录。

## 关键限制
- 只允许在 `{output_dir}/` 目录下创建 `trace.md` 文件
- 不要修改 `{output_dir}/` 中的任何其他文件
- 只记录事实，不做改进建议（那是 meta-agent 的工作）

## 信息来源

回顾本次会话中的以下信息：
- 各阶段的执行结果（成功/失败）
- 评测脚本的输出（`@scripts/evaluate_tilelang.sh`、`@scripts/evaluate_ascendc.sh` 的返回）
- ascendc-performance-analyzer 的性能测试结果
- Agent 的迭代过程（尝试了什么、失败了几次、最终如何解决）
- 遇到的错误信息

补充约定：
- TileLang 当前主要用于设计表达，不默认作为 correctness / performance gate
- 若未执行 TileLang 验证，或因 TileLang 自身 bug 明确跳过验证，应如实记录为“跳过”并写明原因

{"content": "# Trace: MaxPool3d

- 时间: 2026-06-29
- 算子: 27_MaxPool3d
- 设计路径: TileLang (复杂算子)
- 最终结果: SKIP (tilelang) | PASS (ascendc)

## 阶段零: Case 精简

- 结果: 通过
- 原始 case 数: 50
- 精简后 case 数: 10
- 备注: 覆盖 float32/float16/bfloat16, kernel_size 2/3/5, stride 1/2, padding 0/1/2, ceil_mode false/true, 最小/最大 shape

## 阶段〇.五: 设计文档 (仅简单算子路径)

- 结果: 跳过(走 TileLang 路径)
- 说明: MaxPool3d 属于 Pooling 类复杂算子，走 TileLang 设计表达路径

## 阶段一: TileLang (仅复杂算子路径)

- 结果: 跳过
- evaluate_tilelang.sh 执行次数: 0
- 关键错误信息: 无
- Agent 行为记录:
  - 第 1 轮: 参考 archive_tasks/avg_pool3_d 设计模式，生成 block_level/max_pool3d.py (block 分解 + pipeline 骨架)、tile_level/max_pool3d.py (完整 max pooling 计算)、model_new_tilelang.py (NDHWC 布局变换 + kernel 调用)。AST 退化检测通过。
- 走偏点: 无。按 TileLang Programming Guide 的明确说明跳过 TileLang 验证（编译器不成熟）。
- 备注: TileLang 设计表达完成，主要作为设计参考输入用于后续 AscendC 转译。

## 阶段二: AscendC

- 结果: 通过
- 设计路径: TileLang 转译 (复杂算子)
- 产物: kernel/op_host/max_pool3d.cpp, kernel/op_kernel/max_pool3d_float.cpp, kernel/op_kernel/max_pool3d_half.cpp, kernel/op_kernel/max_pool3d_bfloat16.cpp, kernel/op_kernel/max_pool3d_kernel.h, kernel/op_kernel/max_pool3d_tiling.h, kernel/op_kernel/kernel_common.h, kernel/ops.h, kernel/register.cpp, kernel/CMakeLists.txt, kernel/setup.py, model_new_ascendc.py
- 编译: evaluate_ascendc.sh (cmake + make + whl)
- evaluate_ascendc.sh 执行次数: 8
- 关键错误信息:

  第1-2次尝试（模板类 + KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT）:
  ```
  error: no matching function for call to 'Duplicate'
  AscendC::Duplicate(outLocalFloat_, accLocal, cLen);
  note: candidate template ignored: deduced conflicting types for parameter 'T' ('float' vs. 'LocalTensor<float>')
  ```
  根本原因: `Duplicate` 只接受标量值作为第二个参数，不能用 LocalTensor。需要使用 `DataCopy` 进行 tensor-to-tensor 拷贝。

  第3-6次尝试（分离 kernel 入口文件后）:
  ```
  [Error] sec_name type: 3 is error!
  make[2]: *** [CMakeFiles/kernels.dir/build.make:93: lib/libkernels.a] Error 1
  ```
  根本原因: `KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT(KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1)` 导致的 AICORE linker 错误。多个 kernel 入口文件或特定 KERNEL_TYPE 组合会触发此问题。

  第7次（移除 KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT，float32 非模板类）: 编译成功

- Agent 行为记录:
  - 第 1 轮: 基于 TileLang 设计生成 AspendC kernel，使用 `template<typename T>` 类 + KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_1，编译报 Duplicate 错误。
  - 第 2 轮: 修复 Duplicate → DataCopy，但仍有 Duplicate 调用未修复，编译报同样错误。
  - 第 3 轮: 分离 3 个 dtype kernel 入口为独立 .cpp 文件，出现 "sec_name type: 3" linker 错误。
  - 第 4 轮: 仅保留 float32 入口，linker 错误依旧。
  - 第 5 轮: 用 KERNEL_TYPE_MIX_AIC_1_2 替代，linker 错误依旧。
  - 第 6 轮: 构建最小化 stub（无 KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT），编译成功但 host 端因缺少 aclrtlaunch 头文件失败。
  - 第 7 轮: 构建完整的 float32 非模板 kernel（无 KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT 宏），编译成功，10 个精简用例全部通过。
  - 第 8 轮: 添加 half/bf16 独立 kernel 类（MaxPool3dHalfKernel 模板），编译成功，10 个精简用例全部通过。

- 走偏点:
  - 尝试用 `Duplicate(local, local, count)` 进行 tensor-to-tensor 拷贝（该 API 不支持此用法），应直接用 `DataCopy`。
  - 多次尝试不同的 KERNEL_TYPE 宏值（MIX_AIC_1_1 / MIX_AIC_1_2 / KERNEL_TASK_TYPE_DEFAULT），均导致 "sec_name type: 3" linker 错误。最终移除此宏后编译成功。此错误与 KERNEL_TYPE 宏和 CANN 版本、aicore 编译链的具体交互有关。

## 阶段三: 性能分析

- 结果: 完成
- ascendc-performance-analyzer 执行详情:
  - 测试配置: device=npu, warmup=5, repeat=50, seed=0
  - 测试的实现: reference / ascendc
  - 各 case 性能:

| Case | Ref(ms) | AscendC(ms) | Speedup |

| 0    | 0.0144  | 0.0757      | 0.19x   |

| 8    | 1.1274  | 4.0995      | 0.28x   |
| 9    | 0.0061  | 0.0260      | 0.23x   |

  - Overall speedup: 0.85x

  - 性能结论:
    - 总体加速比 0.85x（AscendC 慢于 PyTorch aclnn 参考实现）
    - Case [5] (shape: [1,128,16,32,32], fp16, kernel_size=5) 加速比 6.26x，是小 shape 中唯一超过 reference 的 case
    - 大部分 case 的 AscendC 耗时约是 reference 的 2-5 倍，瓶颈在于 layout transform (permute + contiguous + reshape) 和每个输出元素的独立窗口遍历
    - 参考实现使用 aclnnMaxPool3dWithArgmax（高度优化的 ACLNN 内置算子），布局变换和核心计算均在底层完成
